scaling_mechanism.does_not_apply_to: Interior padding, gaps, element sizes, button heights

failure_scenarios.title: Hardcoded Padding and Gaps Don't Scale
failure_scenarios.issue: Padding and gaps are hardcoded in pixels, not multiplied by menu_scale

at_60_percent.result: Padding consumes proportionally MORE space, content is CRAMPED and offset

at_150_percent.result: Padding consumes proportionally LESS space, layout is LOOSE and sparse

failure_scenarios.impact: Column width calculation becomes incorrect: cw = (ws.x - pad*2 - col_gap)/2
failure_scenarios.visual_consequence: Cards are misaligned and incorrectly sized across different scales

failure_scenarios.title: Button Height Doesn't Scale (btn_h = 28)
failure_scenarios.issue: Unload button height is hardcoded, ignores menu_scale

at_60_percent.result: Button TOWER proportionally, looks MASSIVE relative to card

at_150_percent.result: Button appears TINY, text BARELY readable

failure_scenarios.impact: Button text rendering at extreme scales becomes unreadable; vertical spacing broken
failure_scenarios.visual_consequence: UNLOAD CHEAT button becomes disproportionate to UI

failure_scenarios.title: Card Step Heights Don't Scale
failure_scenarios.code: static constexpr float HEADER_H = 42.0f; static constexpr float CHK_STEP = 28.0f; static constexpr float KB_STEP = 30.0f; static constexpr float CMB_STEP = 52.0f; static constexpr float SLD_STEP = 40.0f;
failure_scenarios.issue: All card element step heights are hardcoded constants, never multiplied by menu_scale

at_60_percent.result: Card headers consume TOO MUCH space; elements pack too densely below

at_150_percent.result: Card headers SHRINK relatively; huge GAPS between elements

failure_scenarios.impact: Checkbox spacing (CHK_STEP=28) doesn't scale; slider spacing (SLD_STEP=40) doesn't scale; keybind height (KB_STEP=30) doesn't scale
failure_scenarios.visual_consequence: Card content appears squeezed at 60%, stretched at 150%

failure_scenarios.title: Icon Sizes Don't Scale (Fixed Pixel Coordinates)
failure_scenarios.code: dl->AddRect(p, ImVec2(p.x + 15, p.y + 10), col, 2.0f, 0, 1.0f); dl->AddLine(ImVec2(c.x - 10, c.y), ImVec2(c.x - 3, c.y), col, 1.3f); dl->AddCircle(c, 7, col, 22, 1.3f);
failure_scenarios.issue: All icon drawing uses hardcoded pixel offsets: 15, 10, 7, 10, 3, etc. These are NEVER multiplied by menu_scale

at_60_percent.result: Icons appear OVERSIZED relative to shrunk window, look PIXELATED/chunky

at_150_percent.result: Icons appear UNDERSIZED relative to enlarged window, look TINY and hard to see

failure_scenarios.impact: Tab icons (crosshair, eye, globe, etc.) stay same pixel size regardless of scale
failure_scenarios.visual_consequence: UI icons become visually inconsistent with window size

failure_scenarios.title: Hardcoded Element Sizes in Card Methods
failure_scenarios.code: float sz = 12.0f; (checkbox) | float bw = 68, bh = 19; (keybind button) | float tw = 28, th = 14; (toggle)
failure_scenarios.issue: Checkbox size (12px), keybind button (68x19px), toggle switch (28x14px) are all hardcoded

at_60_percent.result: ALL interactive elements GROSSLY OVERSIZED relative to text

at_150_percent.result: All interactive elements UNDERSIZED relative to text

failure_scenarios.impact: Checkbox clickability and visual hierarchy broken; toggles misaligned
failure_scenarios.visual_consequence: Interaction targets don't match visual representation

failure_scenarios.title: Text Positioning and Offsets Don't Scale
failure_scenarios.code: dl->AddText(ImVec2(pos.x + pad_x, pos.y + 13), ...); dl->AddText(ImVec2(cp.x + sz + 7, cp.y - 2), ...);
failure_scenarios.issue: Text positioning uses hardcoded offsets: +13, +7, +20, -2, +16, +6, +10, etc.

at_150_percent.result: Text overlaps with elements or positioned too close

failure_scenarios.impact: Text baseline alignment broken at extreme scales
failure_scenarios.visual_consequence: Text appears floating or crushing into elements

failure_scenarios.title: Window Offset Animation Not Scaled
failure_scenarios.issue: Window fade-in animation offset is hardcoded at 14.0f pixels
failure_scenarios.visual_consequence: UI pops in at different visual velocities depending on scale

failure_scenarios.title: Combo Box Height Doesn't Scale
failure_scenarios.issue: Combo box height is hardcoded at 26px, only width scales
failure_scenarios.impact: Dropdown controls look wrong at non-100% scales

failure_scenarios.title: Card Rounding and Border Widths Don't Scale
failure_scenarios.code: dl->AddRectFilled(pos, ImVec2(pos.x + w, pos.y + h), bg, 8.0f); dl->AddRect(bp, ImVec2(bp.x + bw, bp.y + bh), brd, 3.0f, 0, 1.0f);
failure_scenarios.issue: Border radius (8.0f, 4.0f, 3.0f) and border thickness (1.0f, 1.3f) are hardcoded
failure_scenarios.impact: Card aesthetics change at different scales

failure_scenarios.title: Text Height Calculations Become Wrong
failure_scenarios.code: y += 16; (hardcoded label height) | char val[32]; ... ImVec2 vs = ImGui::CalcTextSize(val);
failure_scenarios.issue: Text label spacing uses hardcoded y += 16 but ImGui text size doesn't scale with menu_scale

at_60_percent.result: Text spacing wrong; labels don't align with values

failure_scenarios.visual_consequence: Elements overlap or have wrong gaps

root_cause.problem: menu_scale only affects window outer dimensions (line 500: scaled_size = base_size * menu_scale), but ALL interior layout calculations use hardcoded pixel values
root_cause.why_it_breaks: When window scales to 60% or 150%, all the padding, button heights, icon sizes, checkbox dimensions stay the same pixel count. This causes proportional misalignment.
root_cause.missing_implementation: No multiplication of any element dimensions by menu_scale inside RenderGui() and Card class methods
